blocks.text: Cucumber Trellis for Raised Beds, Adjustable Size A-Frame Garden Trellis for Climbing Plant Outdoors with Climbing Net and Plant Support Clip for Vegetable Grape Tomato Bean Pea

items.label: 【Package included】
items.value: Crafted from robust hollow steel, this garden stakes features a fade-resistant green plastic coating, offering reliable protection against wind, rain, and rust. This Trellis for Climbing Plants Outdoor comes complete with everything you need to get started: 17pcs metal stakes, 8pcs T shape connect pipe, 2 A-shaped connectors, and a 0.9x1.8meter bird net.

items.label: 【Innovative Equal Tee and Equal Cross Design】
items.value: Experience unparalleled stability with the inclusion of 8 equal Tee in our cucumber trellis. This thoughtfully designed vegetable trellis ensures that your cucumber plants, as well as other climbing plants like beans and tomatoes, stand firm and secure throughout the growing season.

items.label: 【Effortless Assembly and Modification】
items.value: Enjoy a hassle-free setup with the straightforward assembly of the Cucumber Trellis. The inclusion of 2 A-Fork connectors simplifies the modification process, allowing you to adjust the trellis size effortlessly for a variety of climbing plants, such as beans, grapes, and squash. Spend more time enjoying your garden and less time on complex assembly with our versatile vegetable garden supplies.

items.label: 【Effortless Assembly and Modification】
items.value: Enjoy a hassle-free setup with the straightforward assembly of the pea Trellis. The inclusion of 4 A-Fork connectors and 4 Straight Connectors simplifies the modification process, allowing you to adjust the trellis size effortlessly for a variety of climbing plants, such as beans, grapes, and squash. Spend more time enjoying your garden and less time on complex assembly with our versatile vegetable garden supplies.

items.label: 【Optimized Growth Conditions】
items.value: Maximize the potential of your cucumber plants and other climbing vegetables with our thoughtfully designed trellis. The A-Frame structure, coupled with the special Equal Tee and Equal Cross design, ensures that your cucumbers, beans, tomatoes, and other climbing plants receive adequate sunlight, air circulation, and support. Create an ideal environment for healthy growth with our reliable and adaptable garden trellises.
